svg.title: Microsoft Entra roles and Azure RBAC roles
svg.desc: Layout follows the roles diagram on Microsoft Learn. Top panel: Microsoft Entra roles, such as Global Administrator and User Administrator, for the Microsoft Entra tenant. A line from the tenant goes down to the root of the Azure hierarchy. A box on the right says a Global Administrator who has elevated access, or a User Access Administrator, can act at that root. Bottom panel: Azure RBAC roles, such as Owner, Contributor, Reader and User Access Administrator, apply down a staircase of scopes: root management group, management group, subscription, resource group and resource. Icons are official Azure and Microsoft Entra icons.
